title: Graduate Descent
body:
Mir wants to build a model to predict the probability that he will get into each graduate school he applies to. He comes up with the following loss function with the corresponding gradient vector:

$$L(	heta_0,	heta_1)= rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i- rac{	heta_0}{x_i}-\log(	heta_1)x_i+	heta_{0}	heta_1(x_i**{2}+1))$$

$$ rac{\partial{L}}{\partial{	heta}}=( rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(- rac{1}{x_i}+	heta_1x_i**{2}+	heta_1), rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(- rac{x_i}{	heta_1}+	heta_0x_i**{2}+	heta_0))$$
lesson: Loss Functions and Gradient Descent B
